scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.adb:run: npm run adb:install && adb shell am start -n com.towergame.app/com.towergame.app.MainActivity
